title: Raasaiyya
desc: Kanhaiya falls in love with Shyamsunder's granddaughter, Anita, and they decide to get married. However, her grandfather fixes her marriage with someone else.

title: Kilinjalgal
desc: When their parents disapprove of their relationship, Babu and Julie, two lovers belonging to different religious backgrounds, face several hardships.

title: Boys
desc: A group of five friends live a carefree life until they face the struggles of adulthood. In an attempt to become independent, they start a music band and strive to become famous.

title: Suyetchai MLA
desc: When Nambirajan's sister's would-be father-in-law insults him and challenges him to amass name and wealth, Nambirajan strives hard to become a powerful politician.

title: Ramanaa
desc: Ramanaa, a professor, heads a secret group that eliminates corruption from society. They kidnap 15 most corrupt employees from each government department and kill the most unscrupulous one.
